what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at LMS Collaborative Room #D132, or via Zoom (link printed on agenda: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83227847126, Meeting ID: 832 2784 7126)
preview.hook: Hiring a Business Administrator, Finance Office staffing, and warrant articles for Town Meeting
preview.one_line: Lunenburg School Committee, Sept 16, 7pm hybrid: votes on a Business Administrator hire, Town Meeting warrant articles, and SC operating protocols.

items.why_it_matters: The committee is being asked to approve payment of town warrants totaling $74,790.28.

items.agenda_line: a. Vote to Request Warrant Article(s)be Placed on Town Meeting Warrant (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee may vote to put one or more articles before Town Meeting, which decides funding and policy questions residents vote on.

items.agenda_line: b. Request for LHS Parent Teacher Conference Date Change (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: A change to the high school's parent-teacher conference date would affect families' schedules.

items.agenda_line: c. Vote to Approve SC Operating Protocols (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee may formally adopt its own rules for how it conducts meetings and business.

items.agenda_line: d. Vote on Business Administrator Position (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee may take a vote related to filling the district's Business Administrator position.
The committee will discuss draft goals for evaluating the Superintendent.
The committee will discuss staffing levels in the district's finance office.
The committee will take action on its own set of goals for the year.
The committee will discuss restarting joint budget coordination meetings with other town boards.
